inventaires.regle: Mandatory count twice a week (Wednesday and Sunday). Physically count each material. A gap above 5% sends the count to the owner for approval; otherwise the stock is adjusted immediately.

cycle.regle: The head of production of the week proposes the plan from the orders, the manager approves it, then the head opens production at kneading and closes it after baking. Closing records the stock issues.

reste.sous: Updated each time output is entered. The cash desk and manager see it live.

plan.origineSous: The plan adds up three sources. Only orders are typed in; estimated demand is calculated; the extra is decided by the head baker.

sources.commandesDetail: Entered by the cashier in Session → Orders, until 18:30 for night and 05:30 for day.
sources.estimeeDetail: Regulars without an order ({{habituels}}) and counter sales, average of the last 4 sessions of the same type ({{guichet}}).
sources.supplementDetail: Added by the head of production. Approved with the plan, or through a request to the manager once the plan is approved.
